mapper.select: SELECT t.tee_time_id, t.golf_course_id, gc.course_name, t.course, t.play_date, t.start_time, t.hole_type, t.capacity, t.green_fee, t.tee_time_status, r.reservation_id, r.reservation_no, r.reservation_status, r.player_count, m.member_id, m.member_name, m.phone AS member_phone FROM golf.tee_time t LEFT JOIN golf.golf_course gc ON gc.golf_course_id = t.golf_course_id LEFT JOIN golf.reservation r ON r.tee_time_id = t.tee_time_id AND r.reservation_status IN ('PENDING', 'PENDING_PAYMENT', 'PAYING', 'CONFIRMED') LEFT JOIN golf.member m ON m.member_id = r.member_id WHERE t.play_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND t.golf_course_id = #{courseId} AND t.tee_time_status = #{status} ORDER BY t.play_date, t.start_time, t.golf_course_id, t.course
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO golf.tee_time (golf_course_id, course, play_date, start_time, hole_type, capacity, green_fee, tee_time_status, version) VALUES
(#{t.golfCourseId}, #{t.course}, #{t.playDate}, #{t.startTime}, #{t.holeType}, #{t.capacity}, #{t.greenFee}, 'OPEN', 0)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
